Synopsis:
    Diplomatic tension is surfacing among the three 2030 World Cup co-hosts (Morocco, Spain, Portugal) over who will host the final. Morocco's PM publicly rebuked his own football federation chief for unilaterally promising Casablanca as the final venue ahead of elections, while Spain's FA head countered by asserting Spain's claim as defending champions. FIFA has yet to decide. Morocco's 115,000-seat stadium remains only ~30% complete with a 2027 target completion.
